Name: Dinner With Spouse
Author: slpOff
Description:
After a long day on the farm, come home and spend a little time together.
[b]Dinner With Spouse[/b] adds a daily dinner invitation to married life in Stardew Valley. Prepare a meal for your spouse and see what they think of your cooking—or turn down the invitation and they might offer to cook for you instead.
A favorite dish, an awkward first bite, or a quiet evening together can give your daily homecoming a little more personality.

[b]What’s included[/b]
[list]
[*][b]All 12 vanilla spouses:[/b] Abigail, Alex, Elliott, Emily, Haley, Harvey, Leah, Maru, Penny, Sam, Sebastian, and Shane.[/*]
[*][b]360 unique spouse dialogue lines:[/b] 30 per character, with reactions based on their food preferences.[/*]
[*][b]23 possible dishes[/b] in the base menu.[/*]
[*][b]26 supported vanilla dining tables.[/b][/*]
[*][b]One extra serving[/b] of the meal whenever a dinner takes place.[/*]
[*][b]English and Korean[/b] translations.[/*]
[*][b]Optional Cornucopia – Cooking Recipes support[/b], adding up to 496 dishes depending on your installed content and Cornucopia settings.[/*]
[/list][b]How to start dinner[/b]
Enter your own farmhouse between [b]6:00 PM and 10:00 PM[/b] while your spouse is inside and visible. Your own cabin also counts in multiplayer.
Place a supported dining table in the house, leaving the tile immediately to the left of its top-left placement tile and the tile immediately above it clear. Both characters stand beside the table during the event, so chairs are optional.
When the invitation appears, choose whether to ask your spouse to have dinner together.
[list]
[*][b]Choose Yes:[/b] Your farmer prepares a randomly selected dish. Your spouse responds according to whether they love, like, dislike, or hate it.[/*]
[*][b]Choose No:[/b] There is a 50% chance of ending the evening quietly, and a 50% chance that your spouse prepares a meal from their own loved or liked foods.[/*]
[/list]The menu is selected automatically; you do not need to bring ingredients or choose a recipe.
[b]A small daily ritual[/b]
Dinner is available once per in-game day, with no additional heart, season, or weather requirements. Accepting, declining, or skipping the event uses that day’s invitation.
Meals and dialogue are fixed for the day, so leaving and re-entering the house will not reroll the result. The invitation becomes available again the next morning.
Cooking is part of the event and costs no ingredients or gold. Dinner does not change friendship points or count toward gift limits. Both meal branches give you one extra serving to keep, including when you skip the scene.
[b]Requirements and installation[/b]
Requires:
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6[/b][/*]
[*]SMAPI [b]4.0 or later[/b][/*]
[*]Content Patcher [b]2.8.0 or later[/b][/*]
[*]FFT ( slO.FFT ) [b]1.0.0 or later[/b][/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu, required by FFT[/*]
[/list]Install the required mods, extract the
 [CP] DinnerWithSpouse
folder into your Mods folder, and launch the game through SMAPI. FFT’s TV example pack is not required.

[b]Compatibility notes[/b]
Cornucopia – Cooking Recipes support activates automatically when installed. Available dinner dishes follow the supported Cornucopia content tiers and settings.
The pack includes support for the 12 vanilla marriage candidates. [b]Krobus, player-to-player marriages, and custom NPC spouses are not included by default.[/b] Tools are provided for authors who want to add custom NPC support.
Food reactions use predefined taste lists. Mods that change NPC food preferences require those lists to be adjusted manually.
Use a supported vanilla dining table; coffee tables, end tables, tea tables, and tables added by other mods are not included. To trigger the invitation, enter the house during the evening window—remaining indoors until 6:00 PM will not start it.
